atoms.b: When searching for information, you should find a website that suits your ((++purpose opinion)). The ((++target_group colours)) of the website should be appropriate. When you find important information, you should ((++note_it_down memorize_it)) or save it on your computer. Always remember to write down the ((++source time)). If you need pictures, you can download them from the internet. However, even for pictures you have to give the source and ((++name_of_the_photographer location)) when using them.
A part of a published text is written in quotation marks while the source is given. In English, you use “…”.
Information of a published text is being used in other words. There are no quotation marks and the source is given.
Information or even the wording of a source are copied without quotation marks or naming a source.
